name: Multi-Source Incident Reconstruction
description: Complex multi-source incident with mixed timezones, clock skew, malformed records, and cross-source correlation requirements.

files.timezone_note: No year in syslog timestamps — must be inferred from context
Timestamps in IST (+05:30) — must be converted to UTC

files.clock_skew_note: This firewall is approximately 5 minutes ahead of NTP — noted in data

expected_detections: SSH brute force from 203.0.113.47 (visible in syslog and firewall)
Successful login after repeated failures (cross-source correlation)
Bulk data export (15420 records) to external service
Clock skew warning for firewall source
Parsing failures in syslog and CSV
complexity_notes: Syslog timestamps lack year — must be estimated or marked SYSLOG_NO_YEAR
App events in IST timezone (+05:30) — must convert to UTC
Firewall has documented clock skew (~5 minutes)
One JSON event has null timestamp — must be flagged MISSING
One syslog line is completely malformed
Two CSV rows are malformed (wrong column count, missing timestamp)
